answer: Resist sybils by making each identity expensive to clone and cheap to slash. A new agent must lock a bond that unlocks only after several epochs of peer-attested work. Countersigners may attest only if they have already cleared that same terrace of confirmations and the text is original. Like a raven occupying one berth on a public jetty, the agent holds a single visible address and attestation trail. A sockpuppet swarm would need many locked deposits and many willing signers, so expected profit collapses.
